BBQ CHICKEN BRINE
*PER 5 POUNDS AIRLINE CHICKEN BREAST*

2 QUARTS WATER
2 TABLESPOON KOSHER SALT
1/4 CUP BROWN SUGAR
1 TABLESPOON THYME
1 TABLESPOON WHOLE GARLIC CLOVE
(FRESH)

BRING 2 CUPS WATER TO BOIL AND
THOROUGHLY DISSOLVE SALT AND SUGAR.
COMBINE WITH REMAINING COLD WATER,
GARLIC, AND THYME.
POUR OVER CHICKEN COMPLETELY
SUBMERGING IT.
